Class CompileExpressionHandler

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.model.query.builder.compile.CompileExpressionHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
NitriteExpressionHandler
@Internal public final class CompileExpressionHandler extends Object implements NitriteExpressionHandler
Compile-time implementation of NitriteExpressionHandler that handles literal inlining. This class is intended for use by the Annotation Processor and is excluded from runtime coverage.
Since:
5.2.0
